summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K (US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K) announcing an increase to the Maximum Tender Amount of its previously announced cash tender offer for its $3,000,000,000 6.000% Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities (callable May 22, 2027), raising the cap from $1,000,000,000 to $1,500,000,000 in aggregate principal. Purchase price is 100.50% ($1,005.00 per $1,000 principal) plus accrued interest, with a $200,000 minimum tender and $1,000 increments. The offer expires 19 November 2026, with expected settlement 24 November 2026, conditioned on a $1.5bn 7.625% new CoCo issuance, financed with cash on hand. Watch take-up, proration and the new-issuance closing.
